content.text: {"plan":[{"requirement_id":"R1","owner":"blocked_private_input","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Scoping note defining needed position roster, usable salary data, comparator criteria, and public/private input boundaries for a market-salary review."},{"requirement_id":"R2","owner":"blocked_private_input","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Scoping note listing required job-description inputs, review participants, and decision points for longevity incentives and possible staff classifications."},{"requirement_id":"R3","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Recommendation-framework outline describing inputs, evaluation criteria, and approval dependencies for position and compensation change proposals."},{"requirement_id":"R4","owner":"blocked_private_input","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Benefits-review scoping outline identifying required plan documents, comparator set, and categories for health, retirement, leave, and other benefits."},{"requirement_id":"R5","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Benefits-change recommendation template covering option types, rationale fields, dependency tracking, and decision-review checkpoints."},{"requirement_id":"R6","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Salary-step scoping memo defining needed salary-scale inputs, step-policy questions, and governance dependencies for annual step-level recommendations."},{"requirement_id":"R7","owner":"blocked_private_input","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Final-report scoping outline specifying expected sections on research, process, recommendations, rationale, and inputs still required before delivery."}]}
